messages:
Maya R: quick ask — we need a light onboarding perf pass for scorpio-13b-v1. goal: smoke + 1k-token profile on g5 and p4d. configs: batch=[1,4,8], seq=[64,256,512]. target: p50 < 220ms/token, p99 < 1.2s for 512. please include fp16 and q4f16 baseline.

Samir Patel: I can take the runs this afternoon. want both variants on both hw?

Maya R: start with fp16 + q4f16 on both g5 and p4d. if fp16 looks good, we'll iterate q8 later. also include peak memory and cold vs warmed kv cache numbers.

Evan K: kicking off smoke on g5-1 now, will post quick logs.

ci-bot: automated-run: scorpio-13b-v1 smoke (g5-1) started by Evan K at 2026-03-17T14:21:05Z

ci-bot: smoke results (g5-1) 
```
model: scorpio-13b-v1
variant: fp16
default_batch: 1
seq: 512
p50_token_ms: 179
p95_token_ms: 420
p99_tail_ms: 980
mem_peak_gb: 27.4
kv_cache: warmed
```

Liang Chen: g5 looks solid for fp16 — p50 ~180ms/ token at seq512 batch1. p99 under 1s which is great.

Evan K: starting p4d smoke now (fp16). will also run batch4 and batch8 quick profiles.

ci-bot: smoke results (p4d-3) 
```
model: scorpio-13b-v1
variant: fp16
batch=1 seq=512 p50=205ms p99=1120ms mem=30.1GB kv_cache=warmed
batch=4 seq=256 p50=95ms (per-token) throughput=11.2 tok/s
batch=8 seq=64 p50=46ms mem_peak=32.5GB
```

Liang Chen: p4d p50 is ~205ms batch1 seq512, p99 ~1.12s. slight tail degradation vs g5. possible improvement with KV tiling + prefetch.

Samir Patel: noted. I'll open a tiny tiling tweak branch and run a bench sweep against p4d later. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5234 (tiling-prefetch-kvcache)

Maya R: thanks. can you also drop q4f16 numbers once you have fp16 baseline? would like a recommendation for canary (ready / needs work).

Evan K: q4f16 runs queued on both backends — posting consolidated summary in a min.

ci-bot: aggregated-summary 
```
scorpio-13b-v1 summary:
- fp16 g5: p50=179ms tok, p99=980ms, mem=27.4GB -> PASS (meets p50/p99 targets)
- fp16 p4d: p50=205ms tok, p99=1120ms, mem=30.1GB -> WARN (p99 slightly over)
- q4f16 g5: p50=200ms, p99=1.05s, mem=18.6GB -> OK (lower mem, slight perf hit)
- q4f16 p4d: p50=235ms, p99=1.30s, mem=20.2GB -> FAIL (tail > target)
notes: kv-cache warm state used. batching helps throughput but increases p50 per-token variability. recommend tiling-prefetch on p4d before canary for q4f16.
```

Liang Chen: short action items: (1) infra try tiling-prefetch branch on p4d (Samir) (2) rerun q4f16 smoke after tweak (Evan) (3) if q4f16 still fails, plan canary with fp16-only and reserve capacity.

Samir Patel: I'll deploy tiling tweak to a single p4d instance, run the same smoke profiles, and post numbers here by EOD.

Evan K: acknowledgement — queued q4f16 reruns once Samir posts.

Maya R: thanks team. if fp16 passes on both, we can schedule a canary tonight for fp16 variant only. please call out any regressions vs the baseline.

infra-oncall: reserving a small canary window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC for fp16 scorpio-13b-v1. will update if conflicts.

Samir Patel: quick update — deployed tiling-prefetch on p4d-3, smoke run complete: 
```
fp16 p4d-3 seq512 batch1 p50=198ms p99=1050ms mem=30.0GB
q4f16 p4d-3 seq512 batch1 p50=215ms p99=1180ms mem=20.0GB
```

Samir Patel: tiling improved tail ~70ms. q4f16 still close to threshold but better.

Maya R: great. recommendation: canary with fp16 tonight, and hold q4f16 until we validate across more p4d hosts. Evan/Liang can you coordinate extended q4f16 sweep next week?

Evan K: yes — will schedule across three p4d nodes next Tue and share full report.

Liang Chen: I'll add a perf note to the model onboarding doc (links) and mark q4f16 as "post-canary work".

Maya R: closing the loop — fp16 canary approved for tonight. thanks everyone :rocket:
